content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Devon: finally home, 5th was still stupid by the bank
Me: ugh same, i just sat through it instead of taking oak
Devon: i was too lazy to reroute again
Me: cat was already on the clean laundry when i walked in
Devon: of course, tradition at this point
Me: literally only clean, never dirty
Devon: mine was screaming before i even got my shoes off
Me: did you feed her
Devon: yeah gave her treats so she'd chill for a sec
Me: what are you doing for dinner
Devon: probably just toast again tbh, you?
Me: i have leftover soup still i should finish
Devon: the tomato one from last week?
Me: yep, heating it up now before it goes bad
Devon: fair, hey so bad news about our friday thing
Me: oh no what happened
Devon: got put on late shift friday, like till way late
Me: ugh your boss again?
Devon: yeah last minute schedule change, chart hell has returned
Me: that sucks, you work too many lates
Devon: fr, can we move it to sunday instead?
Me: instead of friday?
Devon: yeah just push it, not do both lol
Me: oh good, i can't do two pizza nights in a row anyway
Devon: same, wallet says no
Me: sunday works for me, i have nothing going on
Devon: same time same place just sunday?
Me: yeah that works, keep it easy
Devon: perfect thank you, i felt bad asking
Me: no worries, late shift isn't your fault
Devon: still annoyed tho, i was looking forward to friday
Me: me too, i've been craving those garlic knots all week
Devon: same, they'll hit even better sunday tbh
Me: did your mom still want you to stop by this weekend?
Devon: yeah she mentioned lunch after noon-ish again
Me: is she doing the potato salad again?
Devon: probably, she said she'll make extra just in case you come
Me: tell her i love her, i might swing by
Devon: she'll hold you to that lol, still talks about you demolishing it
Me: i have zero self control with that stuff
Devon: like us with garlic knots
Me: literally didn't even make it home last time
Devon: i ate mine in the car, no shame
Me: same lol
Devon: you doing laundry tonight or tomorrow?
Me: tomorrow, still have clean socks somehow
Devon: wow growth, i'm out again already
Me: growth expired for you?
Devon: expired immediately
Me: soup is almost hot, you gonna do peanut butter toast?
Devon: yeah elite fallback once more
Me: don't burn it like the dough lol
Devon: hey the smoke smell is finally gone, don't jinx me
Me: how's the kitchen now?
Devon: aired out, sweatshirt still smells like campfire tho
Me: toss it in with your socks tomorrow
Devon: plan is plan, ok so we're good for sunday then?
Me: yep, see you then
Devon: i'll text when i'm leaving that day
Me: sounds good, i'll grab table if i'm first like usual",
  "writer_note": "Kept the reschedule light and implicit — Devon proposes Sunday instead to replace Friday due to late shift, and both confirm same time/place without reciting the full plan, while surrounding it with their usual evening chatter about traffic, cats, laundry, and potato salad."
}
